To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the electroweek sphaleron can be replaced by a new gauge interaction that is responsible for dark matter production.
a new sphaleron can convert a B or L asymmetry to an X asymmetry, which then becomes dark matter.

(a) The dark matter mass is determined by a ratio of B and X, which in turn is determined by a sphaleron rate ratio; (b) The dark matter can be either baryon-like or lepton-like; (c) The baryon-to-entropy ratio can be determined by a sphalon rate ratio and a ratio of B, L and X; and (d) The dark matter and the dark radiation can be determined by the same sphaleron rate
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following question: can a unified gauge group with larger rank than the SM be consistent with the dark matter abundance and relic density?
the possibility of dark matter production by non-standard-model (NSM) sphalerons.
a new class of dark matter candidates that are baryons and leptons of an extended gauge symmetry.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the dark matter mass is predicted in the range (1-100) GeV.
the dark matter particle mass is in the range 1.5–4.5 GeV.
the dark matter is a new fermion, which is a singlet under the SM, but not under the larger group.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
in a wide variety of models the dark matter mass is predicted to be around 1 GeV.
the dark matter mass is predicted to lie in a narrow range around 5 TeV.
the mass of the DM particle is in the range (1 − 100) MeV, and its annihilation cross-section is in the range 10 −29 −10 −25 cm 2.
The main takeaway from our work is that
dark matter can be produced in the same way and with the same efficiency as baryons, and thus that dark matter is not a fine-tuned accident.
the dark matter particle mass is determined by the sphaleron equilibrium conditions and is thus calculable, and the dark matter particle is a gauge singlet.
the dark matter particle can be predicted in a natural way in unified theories.
